description: Retrieve information about LXD storage pools.

parameters.name: client_cert
parameters.description: The client certificate file path. If not specified, it defaults to $HOME/.config/lxc/client.crt.

parameters.name: client_key
parameters.description: The client certificate key file path. If not specified, it defaults to $HOME/.config/lxc/client.key.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of a specific storage pool to retrieve information about. If not specified, information about all storage pools are returned.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Project of the storage pool. See https://documentation.ubuntu.com/lxd/en/latest/projects/.

parameters.name: snap_url
parameters.description: The Unix domain socket path when LXD is installed by snap package manager. Default: "unix:/var/snap/lxd/common/lxd/unix.socket"

parameters.name: trust_password
parameters.description: The client trusted password. You need to set this password on the LXD server before running this module using the following command: lxc config set core.trust_password <some random password> See https://www.stgraber.org/2016/04/18/lxd-api-direct-interaction/. If trust_password is set, this module sends a request for authentication before sending any requests.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter storage pools by driver/type (for example dir, zfs, btrfs, lvm, or ceph). If not specified, all storage pool types are returned. Can be a single type or a list of types. Default: []

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The Unix domain socket path or the https URL for the LXD server. Default: "unix:/var/lib/lxd/unix.socket"

examples:
- name: Get information about all storage pools
  community.general.lxd_storage_pool_info:
  register: result

- name: Get information about a specific storage pool
  community.general.lxd_storage_pool_info:
    name: default
  register: result

- name: Get information about all ZFS storage pools
  community.general.lxd_storage_pool_info:
    type:
      - zfs
      - ceph
  register: result

- name: Get information about ZFS and BTRFS storage pools
  community.general.lxd_storage_pool_info:
    type:
      - zfs
      - btrfs
  register: result

- name: Get storage pool information via HTTPS connection
  community.general.lxd_storage_pool_info:
    url: https://127.0.0.1:8443
    trust_password: mypassword
    name: default
  register: result

- name: Get storage pool information for a specific project
  community.general.lxd_storage_pool_info:
    project: myproject
  register: result

return_values.name: logs
return_values.description: The logs of requests and responses. Returned: when ansible-playbook is invoked with -vvvv. Sample: [{"request": {"json": null, "method": "GET", "timeout": null, "url": "/1.0/storage-pools"}, "response": {"json": {"status": "Success", "type": "sync"}}, "type": "sent request"}]

return_values.name: storage_pools
return_values.description: List of LXD storage pools. Returned: success Sample: [{"config": {"source": "/var/lib/lxd/storage-pools/default"}, "description": "Default storage pool", "driver": "dir", "locations": ["none"], "name": "default", "status": "Created", "used_by": ["/1.0/instances/container1"]}]

return_values.name: config
return_values.description: Configuration of the storage pool. Returned: success

return_values.name: description
return_values.description: Description of the storage pool. Returned: success

return_values.name: driver
return_values.description: The storage pool driver/type. Returned: success

return_values.name: locations
return_values.description: Cluster member locations for the pool. Returned: success

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: The name of the storage pool. Returned: success

return_values.name: status
return_values.description: Current status of the storage pool. Returned: success

return_values.name: used_by
return_values.description: List of resources using this storage pool. Returned: success
